info.title: API.SH: Cardmarket
info.description: The Cardmarket API from API.SH: public Cardmarket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Cardmarket's own product search with live marketplace data: each product with id, name, link, expansion, rarity, collector number, the number of items on sale and the lowest current price (EUR). Filter by expansion, rarity and category ids (the first page lists the category and rarity ids), exact name and in-stock only; sort by popularity, price, name, collector number or release date. Page with `page` (50 per page); `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-marketplace-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when expansion is given).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

parameters.name: only_available
parameters.description: true: only products on sale now.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity, price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc, number_asc, number_desc, oldest, newest.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The marketplace page of one product: name, rarity, expansion, number of versions, available items, from price, price trend and 1/7/30-day averages, rules text, image, the average sell price history, and the current offers (cheapest first): offer id, seller username, seller type (private, professional, powerseller), seller sales and available items, item location, condition, language, extras (foil, signed, altered, first edition ...), the seller's comment, price (EUR), quantity and the seller's scan when there is one. Filter like the site: language, seller country and type, minimum condition, foil, signed, altered, first edition, reverse holo, playset, minimum quantity. Pass a product page link as `url`, or `game` and the product `id`. Logged out, Cardmarket shows the first 50 offers for the chosen filters; `more_offers_hidden` is true when there are more (narrow them with the filters).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-offers

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product page link on cardmarket.com (or its path).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id instead of url (with game).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Card language(s), comma-separated: names (english, french, german, spanish, italian, japanese, portuguese, russian, korean, s-chinese, t-chinese) or ids 1-11.

parameters.name: seller_country
parameters.description: Seller country/countries: two-letter codes (DE, FR, IT, ES, GB, NL, AT, BE ...) or Cardmarket country ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: min_condition
parameters.description: Lowest condition: MT, NM, EX, GD, LP, PL, PO (or 1-7).

parameters.name: foil
parameters.description: true or false (games with foil printings).

parameters.name: first_edition
parameters.description: true or false (Yu-Gi-Oh! and other games with first editions).

parameters.name: playset
parameters.description: true or false (Magic playsets of four).

parameters.name: min_quantity
parameters.description: Only offers with at least this many copies (1-40).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every printing of one card across expansions (all products sharing its metacard id) with each one's price guide, oldest first, and the cheapest and highest trend prices. Pass a product id of any printing, or the metacard id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-printings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id of any printing of the card.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Cardmarket product by its id (up to 50 comma-separated ids): name, category, expansion id, card (metacard) id, date added and the full price guide (trend, low, average, 1/7/30-day averages, normal and foil, EUR). A single product also lists the card's other printings with their trend and low prices.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cardmarket product id (`idProduct`), or a comma list of up to 50.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Cardmarket product search with price guide
get.description:
Search every product of one game on Cardmarket (singles and sealed: boosters, displays, sets, decks, accessories) by name, with Cardmarket's price guide for each: trend price, lowest price, average sell price and 1-, 7- and 30-day averages, for normal and foil copies (EUR). Filter by expansion, category, card (metacard), singles or sealed, price range and date added; sort by relevance, name, trend price, date added or id. Prices are Cardmarket's daily price guide (`price_guide_created_at`). Page with `page` and `limit`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words of the product name (all must match; accents ignored). Optional when expansion, category, metacard or added_after is given.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

parameters.name: metacard
parameters.description: Card id(s): every printing of the same card shares one (`metacard_id`).

parameters.name: exact
parameters.description: true: the whole name must match.

parameters.name: priced_only
parameters.description: true: only products with a trend price.

parameters.name: added_after
parameters.description: Only products added on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), name, name_desc, price_asc, price_desc (trend price), newest, oldest, id_asc, id_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's public profile: username, type (private, professional, powerseller), sales and available items, member since, rating and the number of evaluations it is based on, the share of very good / good / neutral / bad evaluations (overall, item description, packaging), vacation status, purchase and shipment statistics, the business details professional sellers publish (company name, address, country), and the latest evaluations (buyer username, country, order value band, date, ratings, comment).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-seller

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's shop for one game and category: each offer with the product (id, name, link, expansion, rarity), condition, language, extras (foil, signed ...), comment, price (EUR), quantity and scan, plus on the first page the shop's filter values with counts (expansions, rarities, conditions, languages, foil, signed, altered). Filter by product name, comment text, expansion, rarity, language, condition, foil, signed, altered, first edition, reverse holo, price range and quantity range; sort by price or name. 20 offers per page; `total_pages` as the site shows it (e.g. 100+). Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cardmarket-seller-offers

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game key (default magic): magic, pokemon, yugioh, one-piece, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, digimon, dragon-ball-super, star-wars-unlimited, riftbound, gundam, sorcery and the other games in /cardmarket/v1/games (aliases: mtg, ygo, fab).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: singles (default), boosters, booster-boxes, displays, sets, theme-decks, starter-decks, box-sets, lots, elite-trainer-boxes, tins, accessories, deck-boxes, sleeves, playmats, binders, structure-decks, tournament-packs, collections.

parameters.name: language

parameters.name: condition

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
